Use card() for a single summary surface and card_grid() for a responsive multi-column grid of entity cards that collapses to one column on phones. [ {"type": "card", "title": "Monthly Revenue", "value": "$48,200", "footer": "+14.2% vs last month"}, {"type": "card_grid", "columns": 2, "items": [ {"title": "Docs Agent", "subtitle": "gpt-4o-mini", "tag": "Active", "description": "Answers product and API questions from indexed docs."}, {"title": "Code Reviewer", "subtitle": "claude-3.7", "tag": "Idle", "description": "Reviews pull requests against architecture rules."} ]} ]

Component Parameter Description card title, value, footer Card heading, prominent metric value, and optional footer caption. card_grid items, columns List of card dicts (title, subtitle, tag, description, href, page) and desktop column count.
